topic: descriptive link text instead of click here
hook: Send this to whoever built your website. Those click here links are wasted.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson a day.

Click here. Read more.

Google uses the words inside a link to work out what the next page is about, and its own Search Central guide says link text should be descriptive and relevant to both pages.

So a landscaper in Austin swaps 2 vague words for "See our patio and retaining wall jobs" and both Google and the person on the phone know where that tap goes.

Count yours tonight. I bet you've got at least 2, and you'll fix them in 5 minutes.

#seo #webdesign #seotips #websitetips #seoforbeginners
